title: THE NINJA - the dual-class doctrine: the split experience and hit points, the thief saves, the eleven capabilities with the three ki powers, the family rule with the mission and honor mechanics and the nukenin penalty, Tables 22, 23 and 24
audit_comment: OA round nine (capture pp. 35-39): the ninja - the dual-class doctrine, the capability ladders of Tables 22, 23 and 24, the ki powers, the honor mechanics and the nukenin

banner.title: THE NINJA, printed capture pp. 35-39 - the OA ninja round
banner.provenance: verified against capture pp. 35-39 of the oa.pdf OCR session (single Mistral-OCR capture; cites are capture pages). Two cells settled against the 2018 print BEFORE pinning, per the settling doctrine: the T22 level-2 bound pins as 8,000 (the 2018 8,001 cell contradicts its own next-row floor of 8,001) and the T23 Dex-11 pockets cell pins as -5 (the 2018 05 reading lost its minus against the ladder). The T24 pole-vault column pins in half feet. OCR normalization: 15 points for the bushi class reads as 1-5 points; infraction reads as infravision; 1096 reads as 10 percent (prose only)
banner.sentinel: the gap census after this round: 43 closed, 192 open - the ninja boxes with Tables 22, 23 and 24 flip (census 544 -> 545); NEXT - R623: the Samurai, capture pp. 39-42, Table 25, prefix dgj (verify free), audit "R623 OA samurai audit", include after rules/oaninja.h

consts.name: dgiNinjaHpMin

consts.name: dgiNinjaHpMax

consts.name: dgiNinjaOtherHpDiv
consts.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 36): the other-class hit points - roll the normal die and divide the result by two

consts.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 36): the printed 1st-level bushi/ninja example - from 2 hit points (1-5 for the bushi class plus 1-2 for the ninja class)

consts.name: dgiNinjaExampleHpMax
consts.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 36): the bushi/ninja example upper bound (5 plus 2)

consts.name: dgiNinjaSlots
consts.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 37): two proficiency slots at the beginning usable for the special ninja items

consts.name: dgiNinjaNightingaleDiv
consts.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 37): nightingale floors reduce the move silently chance by one-half

consts.name: dgiNinjaTightropeAngle
consts.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 37): tightrope walking works on surfaces angled at 45 degrees or less

consts.name: dgiNinjaTightropeCheckFeet
consts.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 37): one tightrope check per 60 feet covered

consts.name: dgiNinjaTightropeMove
consts.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 37): the tightrope movement rate, 60 feet per round

consts.name: dgiNinjaTightropeBalanceBonus
consts.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 37): a balancing item increases the tightrope chance by 10 percent

consts.name: dgiNinjaTightropeModerateWind
consts.comment: Ninja prose (capture pp. 37-38): moderate winds lower the tightrope chance by 10 percent

consts.name: dgiNinjaTightropeStrongWind
consts.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 38): strong winds lower the tightrope chance by 20 percent

consts.name: dgiNinjaTightropeGustingWind
consts.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 38): gusting winds lower the tightrope chance by 30 percent

consts.name: dgiNinjaTightropeFightPenalty
consts.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 38): fighting one-handed on a tightrope suffers -5 to hit plus an immediate fall check

consts.name: dgiNinjaVaultRunFeet
consts.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 38): the pole vault needs a 30-foot running start

consts.name: dgiNinjaVaultPoleExtraFeet
consts.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 38): the pole must be at least four feet longer than the character

consts.name: dgiNinjaVaultObstacleReduction
consts.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 38): vaulting atop an obstacle reduces the maximum height by 1 foot

consts.name: dgiNinjaVaultDistanceMult
consts.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 38): a distance vault covers twice the length of the pole

consts.name: dgiNinjaEscapeRoundsDie
consts.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 38): the escape attempt takes 1d10 rounds

consts.name: dgiNinjaOpenLocksPerLevel
consts.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 38): one try per lock per experience level

consts.name: dgiNinjaDisguiseSexDiv
consts.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 37): the opposite-sex disguise chance is reduced by half

consts.name: dgiNinjaDisguisePersonDiv
consts.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 37): impersonating a specific person is one-half the normal disguise percentage

consts.name: dgiNinjaDisguiseObserveDays
consts.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 37): one month of close observation restores the normal impersonation chance

consts.name: dgiNinjaKiBreathLevel
consts.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 39): the breath-holding ki at 1st level - rounds equal to the ninja level

consts.name: dgiNinjaKiWaterLevel
consts.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 39): the water-walking ki at 5th level

consts.name: dgiNinjaKiWaterFeetPerLevel
consts.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 39): the water walk crosses 5 feet of water per ninja level

consts.name: dgiNinjaKiWaterMove
consts.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 39): the water-walking movement rate, 30 feet per round

consts.name: dgiNinjaKiWaterPerDayMult
consts.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 39): the water-walking uses per day equal to the ninja level

consts.name: dgiNinjaKiWallLevel
consts.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 39): the wall-passing ki at 12th level - the ultimate ninja power

consts.name: dgiNinjaKiWallPrepRounds
consts.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 39): three rounds of concentration before entering the wall

consts.name: dgiNinjaKiWallDurationRounds
consts.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 39): the wall pass lasts one round

consts.name: dgiNinjaKiWallFeetPerLevel
consts.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 39): the wall pass moves 1 foot per experience level; not through by the end means death inside

consts.name: dgiNinjaNukeXpMult
consts.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 39): a nukenin needs twice the normal experience points to advance as a ninja - the other class advances normally

consts.comment: Table 22 note (capture p. 36): 300,000 experience points are required for each level beyond 12th

consts.name: dgiT22HpBeyond

consts.name: dgiT23RowCount
consts.comment: Table 23 (capture p. 36): ten rows, Dexterity scores 9 through 18

consts.name: dgiT23FirstScore
consts.comment: Table 23 (capture p. 36): the first ability score row is 9 - the row index is the score minus 9

consts.name: dgiT24RowCount
consts.comment: Table 24 (capture pp. 38-39): twenty rows, levels 1-20

bools.name: dgiNinjaHumanOnly
bools.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 36): the ninja class is only open to human characters

bools.name: dgiNinjaSplitClassOnly
bools.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 36): not an independent class - the character must first qualify for the bushi, sohei, wu jen or yakuza class

bools.name: dgiNinjaNoPrimeBonus
bools.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 36): no prime requisite - the 10 percent bonus never applies to the ninja class even when earned in the other class

bools.name: dgiNinjaNoConBonusHp
bools.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 36): never the high-Constitution hit point bonus on the ninja rolls

bools.name: dgiNinjaOtherHpRoundedUp
bools.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 36): the halved other-class die is rounded up, then the Constitution bonus of that class applies

bools.name: dgiNinjaThiefSaves
bools.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 36): always the saving throw tables of thieves

bools.name: dgiNinjaOtherCombatTable
bools.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 36): the combat table of the other character class

bools.name: dgiNinjaWeaponsNoHonorLoss
bools.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 37): the special ninja weapons (Tables 49, 50 and 51) cost no honor, regardless of the other class

bools.name: dgiNinjaCrossSlotHonorLoss
bools.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 37): bushi/ninja who use other-class proficiencies to master ninja weapons lose honor

bools.name: dgiNinjaOtherClassArmor
bools.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 37): wears the armor of the other class, though certain ninja abilities may not work in armor

bools.name: dgiNinjaMagicItemsUnion
bools.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 37): any magical items of the other class plus the ninja-only items

bools.name: dgiNinjaSilentNoMetal
bools.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 37): move silently cannot be used while wearing metal armor

bools.name: dgiNinjaHideWatched
bools.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 37): hide in shadows cannot be used while someone is watching - the character always thinks he is hidden

bools.name: dgiNinjaHideInfravision
bools.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 37): near a heat source the skill works against infravision - the heat blinds it

bools.name: dgiNinjaTrapsSmallOnly
bools.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 37): find/remove traps works only for small traps, not large ones

bools.name: dgiNinjaTrapsOneAttempt
bools.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 37): only one attempt per character per trap - an equal chance to remove once found

bools.name: dgiNinjaClimbChainMail
bools.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 37): climb walls cannot be used in metal armor other than chain mail

bools.name: dgiNinjaClimbMidpointCheck
bools.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 37): one climb check at the midpoint - failure means the fall at the midpoint

bools.name: dgiNinjaDisguiseClassOnly
bools.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 37): disguise covers any general class of person of about the same height, weight and age

bools.name: dgiNinjaDisguiseFailForever
bools.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 37): once a specific-person impersonation fails, that person can never be impersonated

bools.name: dgiNinjaAssassinatePlanned
bools.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 37): the DMG assassination tables, carefully planned, DM-adjusted - not a combat skill, unusable in melee

bools.name: dgiNinjaVaultNoMetal
bools.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 38): no metal armor when pole vaulting

bools.name: dgiNinjaFallChainMail
bools.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 38): the safe fall allows no metal armor other than chain mail

bools.name: dgiNinjaFallVerticalSurface
bools.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 38): the safe fall needs a reachable vertical surface; beyond the stated distance the full damage applies

bools.name: dgiNinjaEscapeOneAttempt
bools.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 38): one escape attempt only - with guards present it is easily thwarted

bools.name: dgiNinjaOpenLocksLockedForever
bools.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 38): a failed lock never opens - the retry comes at the next experience level

bools.name: dgiNinjaBackstabUnnoticed
bools.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 38): the backstab strikes unnoticed from behind - the usual Strength, class and magic modifiers apply before the multiplier

bools.name: dgiNinjaKiBreathOnceDaily
bools.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 39): the breath-holding ki is usable only once per day

bools.name: dgiNinjaKiWaterBrokenByInjury
bools.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 39): any injury breaks the water-walking concentration

bools.name: dgiNinjaKiWallCostsAllKi
bools.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 39): the wall pass needs the entire day ki - disturbance loses this and all other ki powers for the day

bools.name: dgiNinjaFamilyRule
bools.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 39): ruled absolutely by the head of the family - disobedience brings assassination attempts until the character dies or slays the head

bools.name: dgiNinjaIdentityCost
bools.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 39): discovery of the true identity costs honor - others may know he is a ninja but never who he is

bools.name: dgiNinjaMissionRetryable
bools.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 39): failing a mission costs honor but the mission can be attempted again

bools.name: dgiNinjaMissionRefusalAllHonor
bools.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 39): refusing a mission loses all honor - defiance of the head of the family

bools.name: dgiNinjaHonorAboveFamily
bools.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 39): the ninja must maintain his honor above the family honor - the ninja honor measures obedience and loyalty

bools.name: dgiNinjaNukeDeathOrNukenin
bools.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 39): failing that carries the same punishment as disobedience, death - a survivor is a nukenin

bools.name: dgiNinjaMissionsFromHead
bools.comment: Ninja prose (capture p. 39): all missions come from the head of the family - the DM may forbid missions against player characters

tables.name: dgiT22Grid
tables.comment: the Table 22 ninja advancement grid (capture pp. 35-36)
col_comments: the experience column: the upper xp bound of each level, 4,000 at 1st to 1,900,000 at 12th (capture pp. 35-36).
the hit points per level column: the printed 1-2 range through 9th, then 1 for the 10th through 12th rows (capture pp. 35-36).
tables.audit_comment: the Table 22 grid: the xp bounds and the hit points per level (capture pp. 35-36)

tables.name: dgiT23Grid
tables.comment: the Table 23 ninja Dexterity adjustments grid (capture p. 36)
col_comments: the picking pockets column: -15 percent at Dex 9 to +10 at 18 (capture p. 36).
the locating and removing traps column: -10 percent at Dex 9 to +5 at 18 (capture p. 36).
the moving silently column: -20 percent at Dex 9 to +10 at 18 (capture p. 36).
the hiding in shadows column: -10 percent at Dex 9 to +10 at 18 (capture p. 36).
the open locks column: -15 percent at Dex 9 to +10 at 18 (capture p. 36).
tables.audit_comment: the Table 23 grid: the five thief-skill Dexterity adjustments (capture p. 36)

tables.name: dgiT24Grid
tables.comment: the Table 24 ninja capabilities grid (capture pp. 38-39)
col_comments: the hide in shadows column: 10 percent at 1st to 99 at 20th (capture pp. 38-39).
the move silently column: 15 percent at 1st to 99 from 17th (capture pp. 38-39).
the find and remove traps column: 20 percent at 1st to 95 from 13th (capture pp. 38-39).
the climb walls column: 85 percent at 1st to 99 from 15th (capture pp. 38-39).
the disguise column: 20 percent at 1st to 96 at 20th (capture pp. 38-39).
the open locks column: 25 percent at 1st to 99 from 17th (capture pp. 38-39).
the tightrope walk column: 20 percent at 1st to 99 at 20th (capture pp. 38-39).
the pole vault column in half feet: 16 (8 feet) at 1st to 36 (18 feet) at 20th (capture pp. 38-39).
the fall column: 0 feet at 1st and 2nd, then 10 at 3rd climbing 5 per level to 95 at 20th (capture pp. 38-39).
the escape column: 10 percent at 1st to 86 at 20th (capture pp. 38-39).
the backstab multiplier column: x2 at 1st, x3 at 5th, x4 at 10th, x5 at 20th (capture pp. 38-39).
tables.audit_comment: the Table 24 grid: the eleven capability columns, levels 1-20 (capture pp. 38-39)
